2026/27 J1: Tokyo Verdy have four league goals in ten matches, scored by Hayashi, Mizoguchi, and Arai—not by their forwards. 相馬監督は城福体制を否定するためではなく、前線から奪う守備と攻撃への移行を組み直すために呼ばれた。Two losses under his management cannot isolate his impact, especially after a first-half red card. 公式会見をもとに変化と未検証の課題を整理する。
